title: Alien: Resurrection
tagline: Took them eight goes to get Ripley right. Dinner gets one.
about: Two hundred years after her death, Ripley is cloned by military scientists who want what she was carrying.
cue: Serve the snacks when the Betty docks with the Auriga and the smugglers come aboard with their cargo.

Tip the yolks into a bowl.Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, curry powder and salt and pepper until smooth.Pipe or spoon the filling into the 8 whites, dust with the smoked paprika and scatter with the chives.Basketball court gougèresLittle French cheese puffs made with gruyère and a grating of nutmeg, served warmHow to make it125ml water50g butter75g plain flour2 eggs80g gruyère, finely grated1/4 tsp ground nutmegsalt, a pinchHeat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper. Bring the water, butter and salt to the boil in a saucepan.Tip in the flour all at once and beat with a wooden spoon over the heat until it forms a smooth ball that leaves the sides, about 2 minutes.Take off the heat and cool.Beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy, then stir in most of the gruyère and the nutmeg.Pipe or spoon 16 small balls onto the tray and top with the rest of the gruyère.Bake until puffed, deep golden and crisp.
